arguments.name: stand
arguments.text: Divide centered columns by their mean absolute deviation.

origin.details: The checked matrix is all numeric. The values are the upper triangle read by rows.
origin.example: x <- matrix(c(1,2, 3,6, 4,8, 7,1), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE); cat(c(as.numeric(daisy(x)), as.numeric(daisy(x, metric="manhattan")), as.numeric(daisy(x, metric="gower")), as.numeric(daisy(x, stand=TRUE))), "\n")
